channel.title: The Brussels Times
channel.description: Latest posts from The Brussels Times.

item.title: Zelenskyy wants to block Russian sky: 'We are warning our partners – days of safety are over'
item.description: Ukraine will, however, respond favourably to requests from its partners not to disrupt flights to Russia “at specific times".

item.title: UN warns world is exceeding dangerous limit of 1.5 degrees for global warming
item.description: This does not mean that the long-term goal of limiting warming to 1.5°C by the end of the century is lost.

item.title: Red Crescent reports 4 deaths at a wedding in US airstrike in Iran
item.description: Four people, including a child, were killed and over 50 injured in a US attack that struck a wedding house in Iran, the Iranian Red Crescent says.

item.title: European gas prices at their highest level since early 2023
item.description: European gas prices top €74 per megawatt hour (MWh), their highest level since early 2023, as renewed escalation in the Middle East pushes up energy markets.

item.title: Belgian biopharma group reaches agreement with US to reduce medication prices
item.description: The agreement specifically pertains to medicines for Medicaid, the public health insurance programme, which helps cover medical expenses for low-income households.

item.title: US Army Secretary Dan Driscoll resigns
item.description: US Army Secretary Dan Driscoll has resigned after months of tensions with Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth, the White House confirmed on Monday.

item.title: Former French P.M. Edouard Balladur dies at the age of 97
item.description: Former French Prime Minister Edouard Balladur has died in Paris at the age of 97, his family told French news agency AFP on Monday.

item.title: Brigitte Bardot's belongings to be auctioned in Paris
item.description: Auction house Millon announces that 285 everyday items once owned by Bardot will go under the hammer in Paris on 21 September.

item.title: Iceland's prime minister calls EU rejection 'victory for democracy'
item.description: More than 80% of eligible voters took part as Iceland decided not to reopen talks to join the European Union this weekend.

item.title: Iceland's rejection no major blow for EU, expert says
item.description: Iceland have rejected reopening EU membership talks in a referendum on Sunday. Professor Hendrik Vos reflects on the consequences for Europe.

item.title: NASA upgrades Hubble telescope with faster, newer model
item.description: NASA has launched the Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope in Florida. The first images are expected to come back next year.

item.title: Iceland votes against EU membership talks
item.description: Icelanders have voted against reattempting talks to join the European Union in a national referendum on Saturday.

item.title: Dutch federation wants FIFA successor without disgraced president
item.description: Gianni Infantino has been under scrutiny for much of the summer. After his latest scandal, though, countries are rapidly pulling out from supporting his candidacy.

item.title: EU delegates visit Rwanda to discuss building return hubs
item.description: Five European countries sent representatives to Kigali for talks over building return hubs for rejected African asylum seekers in the country.

item.title: All Flemish waterways record temperature highs
item.description: Companies can expect bans if the waterways' temperatures stay above the 25°C mark. Warming water creates both ecological and economic risks.

item.title: Belgian Foreign Minister pays quickfire visit to war-torn Niger
item.description: Gunfire was reported in Niamey city centre hours after Maxime Prévot's visit. Maintaining a 50-year-old tie between the nations was seen as paramount by the minister.

item.title: De Wever heads to India for talks with Prime Minister Modi
item.description: De Wever's visit will be the first time negotiations between the two countries' respective prime ministers take place since 2006.

item.title: Iceland holds vote over reopening EU membership talks
item.description: After 11 years, Iceland once more explores joining the European Union in a bid to stabilise a volatile economy. Shared fisheries are the most disputed part of the deal.

item.title: School attack in Sweden: Why TikTok and trusted flaggers failed to remove violent posts
item.description: “The European Commission would welcome the Swedish Coordinator’s assessment of why posts by the perpetrator in the attack fell under the radar.”

item.title: Just under 500 migrants arrived in the United Kingdom in a single day
item.description: About 494 migrants arrived in the United Kingdom on Thursday in the first successful Channel crossings in 10 days.
